title: Wave Defense: Designing Non-Linear Intensity Curves and Mid-Game Buffers
subtitle: An analysis of tower defense wave mechanics, focusing on quantifying wave budgets to construct non-linear intensity curves. The guide details how mid-game buffers regulate player tension and breaks down template-based enemy spawning to optimize resource consumption. It offers a complete design methodology for balancing numbers and enhancing level playability.

breakdown.title: Wave Intensity Curve
bullets: Assign a 'budget' per wave: quantity/HP/speed/special enemy ratio
Segment the curve: tutorial ramp-up → steady growth → peak challenge → recovery reward
Ensure peaks and valleys exist to prevent player fatigue

breakdown.title: Mid-Game Buffer (Recovery Phase)
bullets: Provide build/upgrade time: allow for strategy instead of constant panic
Offer rewards with choices: bonus cash/HP restore/gacha pull
Use buffers for risk: skip next wave early for extra gains

breakdown.title: Template-Based Spawning
bullets: Vary repeated templates: path/spawn point/mix in specials
Estimate 'firepower threshold' for each path to avoid unsolvable waves
